title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
authors: K. He, X. Zhang, S. Ren, J. Sun
before: Adding layers past a certain depth made networks worse, not better.
problem: Gradients degrade through long stacks of transformations.
breakthrough: Add the input of a block to its output, so the block only has to learn a correction.
why: A vision paper, but every transformer block is wrapped in residual connections. Without them, depth does not train.
next: Adopted wholesale by the Transformer and everything after it.
inherits: The skip connection around every attention and feed-forward sublayer.
